tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check availability for a specific list of full domains (e.g. ['acme.com','acme.ai']). Returns availability, renewal details where supplied, and a registrar link. This fast lookup does not supply a registration quote; use search_domain for prices. Up to 25 domains per call.
